Adds to the features of a vector the values of a raster below them: the value at the points and lines, the statistics of the cells inside the polygons.

**Toolbox folder:** Vector Processing<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Raster, Vector<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.RasterCatToFeatureAttribute`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inRaster` | raster file |  |  | The raster on which to map the vector features. |
| `inVector` | vector file |  |  | The vector to use for the geometric mapping. |
| `fNew` | String |  | `new` | The name for the new field to create (if existing, the field is populated). |
| `pPos` | String |  | `middle` | The vertex of the lines where to take the value: start, middle or end. Allowed values: `start`, `middle`, `end`. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outVector` | output file |  | The extended vector. |

**Notes**

A point takes the value of the cell it falls in, a line the one of the cell of its first, middle or last vertex, as set by the position: the middle one is the vertex in the middle of the list of the vertices, not the point at half of the length. The value goes in the new field, or in the existing field with that name. Novalues are written as -9999. The points and lines outside the raster are left out of the output.

A polygon gets four fields, with the name of the new field followed by _min, _max, _avg and _sum: the minimum, maximum, mean and sum of the valid cells with the center inside the polygon. The sum of a raster of rain heights in mm, for example, times the cell area, gives the volume on the polygon, and the mean of an elevation model the mean elevation of a basin.
